theater: 維也納內城與下奧地利戰線

battle.name: 奧地利1848年革命
battle.theater: 維也納內城與下奧地利戰線
battle.brief: 一八四八年三月十三日起，維也納民眾築起街壘，迫使哈布斯堡宮廷讓步：皇帝承諾憲章、出版自由與司法改革，四月下奧地利頒布憲法；然而十月六日起義再度爆發，溫迪施－格雷茨率援軍入城，用重砲連續轟擊城郊街壘，迫使皇室出走。雷管步槍在近距交火中可靠擊發，使守壘的國民守衛隊得以抵擋帝國步兵。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰方是奧地利帝國與境內多族起義聯盟。帝國方以皇帝費迪南德一世為名義最高統帥，維也納守軍由貝勒加爾德元帥所部的城防部隊與帝國步兵營、砲兵營組成，內政與警察權由奧厄斯貝格伯爵掌握；十月平叛時由溫迪施－格雷茨親王率波希米亞與上奧地利兵團入城，隨後以約瑟夫·耶拉契奇男爵率領的帝國軍與克羅地亞部隊接替了匈牙利戰線的指揮。起義方沒有單一首都，先由維也納國民守衛隊與匈牙利、義大利、波蘭志願兵團佔領兵工廠與主要路口，隨後在六月建立由德意志、捷克、匈牙利、義大利、波蘭、斯洛文尼亞與克羅地亞籍議員組成的帝國議會；匈牙利國民大會在三月提出「十二點綱領」並於四月通過《四月法》，奧地利軍隊中亦成立匈牙利軍團與義大利軍團。哈布斯堡宮廷同時面對三重壓力：普魯士與聯邦議會拒絕協助鎮壓，義大利與匈牙利同時開戰，帝國必須把有限兵力分向多個戰區。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Austrian Empire and a coalition of the revolts of its many peoples. On the imperial side the emperor Ferdinand I was the nominal supreme commander; the Vienna garrison was made up of the city defence troops of Field Marshal Bellegarde together with imperial infantry battalions and artillery companies, while the interior and the police were in the hands of Count Anton von Auersperg; in October the rebellion was put down by Prince Windisch-Grätz, who brought in the Bohemian and Upper Austrian corps, and afterwards the imperial army led by Ban Josip Jelačić took over the Hungarian theatre with imperial and Croatian units. The insurgent side had no single capital: the Vienna National Guard and Hungarian, Italian and Polish volunteer corps seized the arsenal and the main intersections, and in June an imperial diet was established with deputies of German, Czech, Hungarian, Italian, Polish, Slovenian and Croatian nationality; the Hungarian national assembly put forward the Twelve Points in March and passed the April Laws in April, and Hungarian and Italian legions were formed within the Austrian army. The Habsburg court at the same time faced pressure from three directions: Prussia and the federal diet refused to help in putting the revolts down, and wars were under way in Italy and Hungary, so that the empire had to divide limited troops among several theatres.
people: 維也納街壘的指揮多由業餘者與國民守衛隊的骨幹軍官輪流擔任，維也納大學的學生與印刷、排版工人在三月最初幾日扮演了主導角色，帝國劇院樂隊指揮奧古斯特·澤林根是第一批上街反對當局的人物之一，其後他成為維也納國民守衛隊的骨幹。哈布斯堡宮廷的關鍵人物是皇帝費迪南德一世：他在一八四八年三月十七日發表詔令，承諾憲章、出版自由與司法改革，又在四月十五日棕枝主日騎馬至聖斯德望教堂前，在頭頂王冠的情況下再次確認承諾，正是這一連串讓步保住了王室的性命，也讓帝國議會得以成立。溫迪施－格雷茨親王是十月平叛的決定者，他以重砲轟擊維也納的工人街區、封鎖街道、切斷支援，最終逼出皇室的出走。奧厄斯貝格伯爵主持警察與情報機關，組織城市內的武裝反擊。耶拉契奇男爵是帝國在匈牙利與巴爾幹戰線的支柱，他以克羅地亞總督的身分率軍作戰，後來受命主持匈牙利戰事。拉約斯·科蘇什在四月成為匈牙利司法部長，主持國民議會的改革；朱塞佩·馬志尼則於三月在米蘭發起共和運動，把城市革命與歐洲民族主義的宣傳結合起來。
peopleEn: The command of the Viennese barricades was shared by amateurs and the trained men of the National Guard; students of the University of Vienna and printing and typesetting workers played the leading part in the first days of March, and the conductor of the court opera, August Zelinger, was among the first to take to the streets against the authorities, later becoming one of the backbone of the Vienna National Guard. The decisive figure at the Habsburg court was the emperor Ferdinand I himself: on 17 March 1848 he issued a decree promising a constitution, freedom of the press and legal reform, and on Palm Sunday, 15 April, he rode before St Stephen's Cathedral with the crown on his head and confirmed those promises once more; it was this series of concessions that saved the dynasty and allowed the imperial diet to be established. Prince Windisch-Grätz was the man who decided the outcome in October: he shelled the working-class quarters of Vienna, sealed the streets and cut off support until the court was driven out of the capital. Count Auersperg controlled the police and the intelligence service and organised armed counterattack inside the city. Ban Josip Jelačić was the pillar of the imperial cause on the Hungarian and Balkan fronts, raising and leading troops as governor of Croatia before taking charge of the Hungarian war. Lajos Kossuth became Minister of Justice in Hungary in April and presided over the reform of the national assembly, while Giuseppe Mazzini set the Milanese republican movement going in March and welded urban revolution to the propaganda of European nationalism.
kits: 本卡的雷管步槍代表的是一八四八年歐洲軍隊的共同技術底層：底火取代火繩，使槍械在雨霧與泥濘中仍能擊發，装藥量得以加大，射程拉長，隊形因而被拉散。奧地利步兵的制式步槍是一八四一年式韋恩德爾雷管槍，三人一組，配刺刀與負背包架，使用紙包或散裝弹藥；帝國另配發弗朗茨·約瑟夫式等雷管火槍給各部隊與砲兵，騎兵與偵察隊使用雷管騎槍。砲兵方面，帝國陸軍以六磅與十二磅野砲、臼砲配合二十四磅攻城砲，一八四八年維也納方面的重砲由帝國砲兵營與要塞砲隊提供，十月平叛時用以轟擊街壘的正是這批攻城砲。起義方的武器來自四面八方：維也納兵工廠的庫存武器在十月被分發給守壘者，匈牙利與波蘭志願兵攜帶各自的雷管步槍與騎槍，義大利軍團使用撒丁王國的雷管火槍，法國共和派與各國流亡者帶來法式一八四〇年式的雷管步槍，正是本卡這一類武器。街道交火中，一支普通雷管步槍的價值在於：守壘者不需要精準的長距射擊，只需要一發能在近距離內可靠擊發的子彈；反過來說，帝國步兵一旦把街壘逐段清出，密集的射擊線便會讓起義者難以招架。
kitsEn: The percussion rifle on this card represents a technological base common to the European armies of 1848: the priming composition took the place of the match, so that weapons still fired in rain, mist and mud; the charge could be increased, the range lengthened, and formations pulled apart in consequence. The standard musket of Austrian infantry was the Werndl percussion rifle of 1841, worked in sections of three, with bayonet and pack frame, and using paper cartridges or loose charges; the empire also issued percussion guns such as the Franz Joseph pattern to the various units and to the artillery, while cavalry and scouting parties carried percussion carbines. On the artillery side the imperial army used six- and twelve-pounder field guns, howitzers and twenty-four-pounder siege pieces; the heavy guns that bombarded Vienna in 1848 came from the imperial artillery companies and the fortress batteries, and it was precisely that siege artillery that shelled the barricades in October. The weapons of the insurgents came from everywhere: the stores of the Vienna arsenal were handed out to the defenders in October, Hungarian and Polish volunteers carried their own percussion rifles and carbines, the Italian legion used the percussion weapons of the Sardinian kingdom, and French republicans and other exiles brought French percussion rifles of the 1840 pattern, the very kind shown on this card. In street fighting the value of an ordinary percussion rifle lay in this: the defender needed no accurate long-range shot, only one round that would go off reliably at close range. The converse held as well: once the imperial infantry cleared the barricades section by section, a dense line of fire was very hard for the insurgents to withstand.
tactics: 三月十三日至十五日的維也納是一場典型的街壘戰：民眾以石塊、推車與樑木封住街口與橋頭，守軍以刺刀近戰與少量火槍逐段清理；帝國步兵無法在狹窄街巷展開，反而被自己的縱隊拖累，十月平叛的做法與此完全相反。十月六日起義重演了這種街壘結構，但這次帝國方採取了系統的砲火準備：重砲在城郊制高點展開，逐段射擊街壘與街區，同時工兵隊在掩護下接近，以爆破與突擊拿下主要路口。國民守衛隊與匈牙利、義大利軍團的守壘者以胸牆與樓房射擊孔構成交叉火力，試圖用近距離火槍與瓶形壕溝延緩帝國步兵的推進；但缺少野砲、缺少騎兵、也沒有外線支援，最終在帝國步兵佔領兵工廠與外環要點後崩解。鄉鎮與各省的起義則多採守城與徵集民兵的方式，農民以長柄農具與獵槍配合守城軍隊，部分地方成立國民警衛隊分區輪值。整體而言，這場衝突的成敗並不取決於步槍的射速，而取決於誰能先用砲火打開街道，以及誰能把城內的守軍與鄉間的稅收、糧秣連成一條線。
tacticsEn: Vienna from 13 to 15 March was a classic barricade fight: the people blocked streets and bridgeheads with stones, carts and beams, and the troops cleared the way section by section with the bayonet and a few muskets; imperial infantry could not deploy in narrow lanes and was in fact impeded by its own columns, and the way the revolt was put down in October was the exact opposite. The rising of 6 October reproduced the same barricade structure, but this time the imperial side prepared its artillery systematically: heavy guns were deployed on the heights outside the city and worked along the barricades and the surrounding blocks, while engineers advanced under cover, using demolition and surprise to take the main junctions. The defenders, drawn from the National Guard and the Hungarian and Italian legions, built crossfire from breastworks and firing loops in the houses and tried to hold the imperial infantry back with close-range musket fire and bottle-shaped ditches; but with no field guns, no cavalry and no support from outside, the defence collapsed once the imperial infantry occupied the arsenal and the outer posts. In the towns and provinces the rising took the form of holding fortified places together with levies: peasants with long-handled farm tools and hunting guns stood alongside the garrison, and in some places civic guards were formed for rotating duty by district. Taken as a whole, the issue in this conflict was never the rate of fire of the musket but who could open the streets with artillery first, and who could link the garrison inside the city to the taxes and provisions of the countryside.
data: 可核對的時間與數字如下。維也納起事始於一八四八年三月十三日，十五日送葬「三月死者」的遊行把衝突推向高潮，十七日皇帝發表讓步詔令；四月十五日棕枝主日，費迪南德一世在聖斯德望教堂前戴著王冠確認承諾；下奧地利三月憲法於三月廿八日頒布，帝國憲法於四月二十五日頒布，匈牙利《四月法》於同一年四月通過。十月六日至九日維也納再度交火，帝國重砲連續轟擊三日，皇室於十月三十一日離開維也納前往因斯布魯克，十二月二日皇帝將國家權力交給十七歲的弗朗茨·約瑟克，並由卡爾大公接掌軍權。戰線在義大利與匈牙利兩地拉長：拉德茨基在七月二十五日於庫斯托扎擊敗撒丁軍，迫使卡洛·阿爾貝托於八月九日簽訂維涅加萊停戰協議；匈牙利方面則要到一八四九年四月十三日維拉戈什投降才告結束。帝國軍在維也納方面的投入以數個營團與砲兵營計；起義方能持續作戰的武裝核心是維也納國民守衛隊與匈、義、波三支志願兵團，規模在數千至一萬之間波動。
dataEn: The dates and figures that can be checked run as follows. The Vienna rising began on 13 March 1848; the funeral procession of the March dead on the fifteenth brought the conflict to its height, and the emperor published his concessions on the seventeenth. On Palm Sunday, 15 April, Ferdinand I confirmed his promises before St Stephen's Cathedral with the crown on his head; the March constitution of Lower Austria was promulgated on 28 March, the imperial constitution on 25 April, and the Hungarian April Laws were passed in the same month of that year. Vienna fought again from 6 to 9 October under heavy bombardment lasting three days; the court left Vienna for Innsbruck on 31 October, and on 2 December the emperor handed the power of the state to the seventeen-year-old Franz Joseph, with Archduke Karl taking over the command of the army. The war was drawn out on the Italian and Hungarian fronts: Radetzky defeated the Sardinian army at Custoza on 25 July, forcing Carlo Alberto to sign the armistice of Vignale on 9 August, and on the Hungarian side nothing was settled until the capitulation of Világos on 13 April 1849. The imperial effort around Vienna was measured in battalions and artillery companies; the armed core that could keep the insurgents fighting was the Vienna National Guard together with the Hungarian, Italian and Polish volunteer corps, whose numbers fluctuated between several thousand and ten thousand.
cause: 起因是哈布斯堡帝國的體制在政治、經濟與民族三方面同時出現斷裂。統治層的問題最直接：費迪南德一世本人缺乏治理意志，首相梅特涅自一八二一年起主持的保守體制把新聞審查、許可制度與警察監視維持到極致，官僚體系與各民族社會脫節。經濟上，多瑙河畔的航運、關稅與森林採伐政策直接觸碰匈牙利、捷克、波蘭與德意志各省的商人與農民利益，鐵路與工業落後的省份把這一落差視為被剝削。民族上，德意志人自居帝國領導民族，而匈牙利、捷克、義大利與波蘭各自要求語言權、地方自治甚至國家地位，這些要求在維也納會議體系的刻意保守之下被長期壓住。直接引爆點是三月初的言論自由要求與軍隊開槍：維也納的學生、工人與守衛隊在十三日前後連續集會，同時巴黎二月革命與米蘭的共和運動傳來消息，帝國各地的城市在同一個月內互相呼應，革命不再是零星事件，而成為可以互相支援的浪潮。
causeEn: The cause was the Habsburg system breaking at once on the political, the economic and the national plane. The failure of the rulers was the most direct of the three: Ferdinand I himself had no will to govern, and the conservative system run by Metternich from 1821 kept censorship, licensing and police surveillance at their tightest, so that the bureaucracy stood apart from every society in the empire. Economically, the navigation, tariff and forestry policies of the Danube touched directly the interests of merchants and peasants in Hungary, Bohemia, Poland and the German provinces, and the provinces where railways and industry lagged behind read that gap as a form of exploitation. Nationally, the Germans regarded themselves as the leading people of the empire, while the Hungarians, Czechs, Italians and Poles each demanded language rights, local autonomy or even a state of their own, and those demands had been held down for years by the deliberate conservatism of the Vienna settlement. The immediate trigger was the demand for freedom of the press and the firing of troops in early March: students, workers and the guard in Vienna gathered repeatedly in the days around the thirteenth, the news of the February revolution in Paris and of the republican movement in Milan arrived at the same time, and the cities of the empire answered one another within the same month. Revolution was no longer a series of isolated incidents but a wave that could support itself.
impact: 一八四八年的失敗從兩方面改變了歐洲。一方面，帝國的自由派與民族運動被武力清剿：維也納的街壘在十月被砲火拆毀，帝國議會被解散，國民警衛隊被解除武裝，匈牙利、義大利與波蘭的革命軍分別在維拉戈什與諾瓦拉敗亡，奧地利重新回到梅特涅式的保守統治之下，並在一八四九年至一八五一年之間以軍法壓制全國；此後帝國改以軍隊與官僚體系置於政治之上的體制治理，這一取向最終在克里米亞戰爭後被費迪南德·約瑟夫推翻。另一方面，革命把民族問題推到了歐洲議程的前列：義大利的民族軍與加里波第在羅馬共和國階段的作為，匈牙利在九月十一日《匈牙利法》的宣示，以及德意志民族議會在聖保羅教堂的集會，共同把民族自決從法國二月革命的附屬要求變成獨立的政治主張。軍事上，十月的街壘戰被後來的技術變革徹底改寫：刺刀與街壘無法抵禦重砲的直射，交戰雙方此後在要塞、稜堡與攻城砲上投入更多資源，帝國陸軍的技術裝備優勢也讓普魯士在同時代對奧地利的競爭中逐漸取得主動。
impactEn: The defeat of 1848 changed Europe in two ways. On one side the liberal and national movements of the empire were crushed by force: the barricades of Vienna were broken down by artillery in October, the imperial diet was dissolved, the National Guard was disarmed, and the revolutionary armies of Hungary, Italy and Poland were destroyed at Világos and Novara; Austria returned to a Metternich-style conservative rule and repressed the country with military law between 1849 and 1851; the empire was thereafter governed with the army and the bureaucracy set above politics, an orientation that was finally overturned by Franz Joseph after the Crimean War. On the other side the revolution pushed the national question to the front of the European agenda: the national armies of Italy and the actions of Garibaldi during the Roman Republic, the proclamation of the Hungarian law on 11 September, and the assembly of the German national parliament in St Paul's Church together turned national self-determination from a corollary of the French revolution of February into an independent political claim. In military terms the street fighting of October was completely overtaken by later technical change: the bayonet and the barricade could not hold against the direct fire of heavy guns, and both sides henceforth put more resources into fortresses, redoubts and siege artillery, while the technical superiority of the imperial army allowed Prussia to gain ground step by step in the competition with Austria of the same era.
result: 結果是革命方在每一條戰線上的失敗，但失敗的樣態並不完全相同。維也納三月的主動權由國民守衛隊一方取得，帝國以讓步換取政權延續；十月再起時，這種平衡被打破，帝國以重砲與援軍把街壘逐段清掉，起義在四日內崩解，皇室出逃。十月的失敗改變了帝國的權力結構：軍隊成為執政者手中的工具，內政與警察權力集中，議會被中止，匈牙利與義大利的戰事則由拉德茨基與耶拉契奇分別收拾。裝備層面的結果同樣可以確定：雷管步槍在近身街壘中能給守壘者以可靠的反擊，卻在重砲的直射面前無能為力；十月的教訓是，在城垣與街壘主導的城市戰裡，野砲與攻城砲才是決定性的一級。帝國在西班牙與義大利的戰線也證明同一點：能讓軍隊擺出密集射擊線並得到砲火支援的一方，往往才是最後的勝者。
resultEn: The result was failure for the revolutionaries on every front, though the shape of that failure was not the same everywhere. In Vienna in March the initiative was taken by the National Guard, and the empire bought the survival of its government with concessions; when the rising came again in October that balance was broken, the imperial heavy guns and reinforcements cleared the barricades section by section, the revolt collapsed within four days and the court fled the capital. The defeat in October changed the structure of power in the empire: the army became an instrument of those in power, the interior and the police were centralised, the parliament was suspended, and the wars in Hungary and Italy were settled separately by Radetzky and Jelačić. The result at the level of equipment can be stated just as clearly: percussion rifles gave the defenders a reliable answer at close quarters in the barricades, but they could do nothing against the direct fire of heavy guns. The lesson of October is that in urban fighting dominated by walls and barricades, field and siege artillery are the decisive tier. The imperial campaigns in Spain and Italy confirmed the same point: the side that could deploy a dense line of fire and had its artillery in support was usually the side that won in the end.
